name: Flex Your Playtime!
desc:
🔍 Welcome to Check your Playtime Hours!

Ever wondered how long you've been playing? Step in and discover your estimated total hours!

🎮 Features:
💰 Tip Jar Donations – Raise Robux or donate Robux to others!
🕒 Get an estimated total playtime!
🔍 Search any player and see how much they've played!
👫 Check how much your friends have played!

⚠️ Donation Notes:
• Roblox Plus required.
• If you're under 18, donations may require parental approval and you may need to rejoin the server.

👍 Like, favorite & join the group for perks!
